segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Morning, thanks for making time.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: No problem, we've got about fifteen minutes.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's start with the renewal pricing, since that's the blocker.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Right. Procurement came back and flagged forty dollars per seat as above the band they approved for this cycle.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: The number they'll sign off without escalation is thirty-five. Anything above that goes to committee and that's a six week delay.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Six weeks would push us past the current term, which nobody wants.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I can't approve thirty-five on my own either. Let me take it to finance and see what the floor actually is.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: How quickly can you come back? We're trying to close this before the end of the month.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thursday. I'll have an answer for you Thursday either way.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Thursday works. Let's hold the slot.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: One thing that might help — if you commit to three years instead of one, the discount maths changes considerably.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: A three year term is interesting but I can't commit to that without security signing off first, and they're still waiting on your SOC 2 report.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: The SOC 2 renewal completed two weeks ago. I'll send the report over today.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me directly and I'll route it to security, that'll be faster than the portal.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Will do. Is the data residency question still open, or did that get resolved?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Still open, honestly. Legal wants written confirmation that customer data stays in the EU region. It's not a blocker for signature but it will be for rollout.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Understood. I'll get that in writing from our platform team as well.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: The other thing I should mention is that we're going to need the SSO integration live before we roll out to the wider team.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's already shipped, it's in the current release. I can walk your team through the setup whenever.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Good, that removes one of my worries. Who would run that session?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Our solutions engineer would. I'll ask her to reach out next week to get something booked.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Next week is tight because of the offsite, but the week after is fine. Let's aim for that.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: The week after it is. So to summarise where we are.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I come back Thursday with a number, you send the three year term past security once you have the SOC 2.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: And I'll confirm whether procurement will move at all on the thirty-five, though I doubt it.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's fair. Anything else before we drop?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: No, I think that's everything. Talk Thursday.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Talk Thursday. Thanks.
